description:
“That's sexual harassment! I've told you that before! I'll sue you!” Ayaka Mizukami, a member of the company's compliance committee, immediately calls out Yuya Takahashi on the distance between him and Chitose Takano as they chat amiably. She warns him that even if he meant no harm, it looks inappropriate. In a company that places a high priority on compliance, she takes action despite knowing she’ll make enemies… and sure enough, she did… Ayaka summons Yuya for a harassment training session. Alone with him in the conference room, Ayuka explains matter-of-factly, not suspecting for a moment that he might fight back. She rants one-sidedly, condemning Yuya’s behavior… “So, does this count as sexual harassment?” Yuya defiantly retorts, grabbing Ayuka’s disproportionately voluptuous and massive breasts as he asks, “How about this?” “Is this sexual harassment too?” Yuya presses forward, groping every inch of her stunned, frozen body. Ayuka struggles frantically to resist, but her efforts... were far too feeble.

(Source: Getchu, translated)
